lines.zh: 我的骨头上有肉，肉在烂。
lines.en: There is flesh on my bones, and it is rotting.

lines.zh: 我走一步，掉下一点东西。
lines.en: Each step, something drops off me.
I walk behind the others.
My knees crack like twigs.

lines.zh: 我不躲阳光，反正已经这样了。
lines.en: I do not hide from sunlight. It hardly matters.
A smell follows where I walk.
I shuffle forward, slowly.

lines.zh: 我朝烟囱冒烟的地方走。
lines.en: I head for the smoking chimney.
Only a few of my fingers remain.

lines.zh: 我歪着走，一条腿短一点。
lines.en: I walk crooked. One leg is shorter.
My ribs show.
I do not run. I would fall apart.
I stand, swaying slightly.
My jaw is loose and will not close.
Something moves, and it is not me.

lines.zh: 我的骨头里有东西在爬。
lines.en: Something crawls in my bones.

lines.zh: 我不觉得疼，也不太清醒。
lines.en: I feel no pain, and little clarity.
I smell myself.

lines.zh: 我的眼窝里有什么在动。
lines.en: Something moves in my eye socket.
I wait for something living.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，像一堆旧柴。
lines.en: I hold still, like old firewood.

lines.zh: 我记得自己不是这样的。
lines.en: I remember not being like this.
Your cleanness makes me uneasy.
I have many things on me.
Standing further off would be wise.

lines.zh: 我一抬手，掉了一只虫子。
lines.en: When I raise a hand, a bug falls off.
I cannot see you clearly; I smell you.
You do not smell of rot.
That makes me uncomfortable.
The thing in your chest is beating loudly.
I shuffle one step your way.
Touch this and it will not wash off.
The piece that fell off is still moving.
My bones have loosened; I hold them in place.
I bend to pick it up and cannot.

lines.zh: 有东西从我伤口爬出去。
lines.en: Something crawls out of the wound.
Backing off, my knee clicks clearly.

lines.zh: 这一下，让我更不清醒了。
lines.en: That left me less clear-headed.
I raise a hand. Still there.
One bone short and I still walk.
You only hastened it.
I hear them moving.

lines.zh: 我嘴里的东西不是吃的。
lines.en: What is in my mouth is not food.

lines.zh: 你把食物举给这身骨肉。
lines.en: You offer food to this rot.
My jaw cannot chew.
That does not suit me.
What I smell is rot.
Just leave it there.
I would only spoil it.
Back up a few steps.
I need something else.
Take that thing away.

lines.zh: 你撞到我，掉下了一只手。
lines.en: You bumped me and a hand fell off.
I bend over; my spine clicks joint by joint.

lines.zh: 碰我一下，你回去要洗手。
lines.en: Touch me and you will scrub your hands later.
That knocked me askew.
One knock and two ribs snap.
Just step back.
Something new is on the ground.

lines.zh: 手指擦过你的袖子，空了。
lines.en: My fingers brush your sleeve and close on nothing.
Again, and I come apart on you.
It is on your boot now.
Not looking like this.

lines.zh: 我身上有很多东西在住。
lines.en: Many things live on me.
What lives on me has other plans.
My kind are in the earth.
Go further away.

lines.zh: 我不想让你也变成这样。
lines.en: I do not want you to become this.
That home had a window facing south.
That door faced south.
That is all I remember.
Leave quickly.
I pick up my own finger.
Pushed back, but it does not sit right.

lines.zh: 这条虫子是从我身上掉的。
lines.en: This bug came off me.
I crush it.
This bone is not mine.
I kick it aside.
The cloth smells of something; I keep holding it.
The rag smells of me.
I wrap it around my hand.
That feels a little better.

lines.zh: 你一靠近，我身上就动了。
lines.en: As you came near, something on me stirred.

lines.zh: 脖子抬起，发出一声脆响。
lines.en: My neck lifts with a dry crack.
That distance is not far.

lines.zh: 我拖着脚，一步步挪过来。
lines.en: I drag my feet toward you, step by step.

lines.zh: 我的身体里有东西醒了。
lines.en: Something in me has woken.
It is looking at you too.
Do not move. I am coming over.
The hand reaches out, short a few fingers.
I did not mean to hurt you.
It wants to strike first.
Further away. Please.
But I cannot hold it back.
They are all awake.

lines.zh: 我听见自己骨头的响声。
lines.en: I hear my own bones.
This time it is different.
I follow you. Slowly.
This leg drags along behind me.

lines.zh: 你每走一步，我就差一步。
lines.en: Each step of yours, I fall one behind.
My hand rises halfway, then drops.
There are more of them on me now.
I shake, and they fall everywhere.
Do not step on them.
Crushing them will not help.
You are breathing fast; I hear it.
I am leaning toward you.
I did not mean to do this.

lines.zh: 骨头缝里的东西都醒了。
lines.en: The things between my bones have all woken.
I truly cannot hold them.
A little closer still.
Stand your ground and do not move.
I say it once more: step back.
They have begun to move.
So am I.
I rake; a nail falls off.

lines.zh: 这一下，把东西带给你了。
lines.en: That passed something to you.
I pushed you to get you clear.
My arm does not obey.
You have been cut.
The wound discolours quickly.

lines.zh: 我咬了一口，牙掉了两颗。
lines.en: I bite; two teeth fall out.
I shake things off me.
They went toward you.
I am backing away, inch by inch.

lines.zh: 你还站着，那还来得及走。
lines.en: Still standing. Still time to leave.
I am sorry. I tried.
I cannot control them.
Go now, while you can.
Do not look back.
I have stopped at last.

lines.zh: 我从土里爬起来，一半身子还埋着。
lines.en: I rise from the soil, half still buried.
Old flesh clings to my bones.
My first action is to cough.
No lungs, and still I cough.

lines.zh: 有东西从我胸口爬出来。
lines.en: Something crawls out of my chest.
I did not shoo it away.
Houses nearby, and lights.
I walk toward the lamp in that window.
My steps are slow and heavy.
I remember which way to go.
I also remember I should not.
I went anyway.

lines.zh: 身上掉下来的东西跟着我。
lines.en: What falls from me follows.
They arrive before I do.

lines.zh: 火把我身上的干肉烧着了。
lines.en: Fire takes the dry flesh on me.
I hit the ground and half of me scatters.

lines.zh: 水把我泡开了，我散在水里。
lines.en: Water loosens me and I come apart in it.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我掀散，骨头飞了一地。
lines.en: The blast scatters me; bones everywhere.

lines.zh: 有东西穿过去，带走了几块。
lines.en: Something passes through and takes pieces with it.

lines.zh: 咒力一碰，我身上全活过来了。
lines.en: The curse touches me and everything on me stirs.
I am not hungry. They are.

lines.zh: 雷打下来，我全身的骨头都亮了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes and my bones light up.

lines.zh: 下面没有土，我散着落下去。
lines.en: No soil below; I fall apart, falling.
